import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:300]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:300])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

def ref_hash(b):
    n=len(b); h=0
    for i,x in enumerate(b): h=(h*257+x+1)%(2**64)
    return '%016x'%h

# huge data frame: receipt fingerprint computed without materialising
N = 3*1000*1000
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'A'*%d"%N]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{big}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('huge frame payload', c['payload_bytes'], N)
# receipt = 8 time + 4 stream + 1 kind + 8 len + N data + 1 end
seg = (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'D'+N.to_bytes(8,'big')
h = 0
for x in seg: h=(h*257+x+1)%(2**64)
h = (h*pow(257,N,2**64) + (0 if False else (sum((65+1)*257**(N-1-i) for i in [0])%2**64)*0)) % (2**64)
# compute data hash by geometric formula: bytes are all 'A' (0x41)
hv = 0
k = N
m = 257
# sum_{i<N} 66*257^(N-1-i) = 66 * (257^N-1)/256
num = pow(257,N,2**64) - 1
inv = pow(256,-1,2**64)
hv = 66*num % (2**64) * inv % (2**64)
h = (h*pow(257,N+1,2**64) + hv) % (2**64)
h = (h*257 + 1) % (2**64)
check('huge frame sent', c['sent'], {'n':22+N,'h':'%016x'%h})

# huge body split across parts, hashed from compressed ranges
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'ab'*500000"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 1000000\r\n\r\n"},
                                          {"case":"a","data":"{{big[0:400000]}}"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"{{big[400000:1000000]}}"}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('split body error', ch['error'], None)
check('split body n', ch['requests'][0]['body']['n'], 1000000)
want = ref_hash(b'ab'*500000)
check('split body h', ch['requests'][0]['body']['h'], want)
check('split committed', ch['committed'], [0,0,1])
check('split owners', ch['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',len("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 1000000\r\n\r\n")+400000],[None,600000]])

# chunked with a huge chunk
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'Z'*700000"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"AAABC\r\n"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"{{big}}"},

           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n"},
